coverage_of_risk.rationale: No tests exist, so none of the data transformation, filtering, URL state, or error paths are covered.

signal_to_noise.rationale: No tests means no low-value tests; per rubric this is a neutral 3, though it reflects absence rather than discipline.

findings.issue: Per-species fetch failures in the dex index are swallowed to null and cached for the process lifetime, silently stripping sprites/types from lists; nothing would catch this
findings.suggestion: Unit-test getDexIndex against a mocked API with one failing pokemon, and surface/log partial failures instead of caching them

findings.issue: Generation sort key regex (\d+)$ never matches Roman-numeral names (generation-i), so all keys are 0 and ordering survives only because the API lists generations sequentially
findings.suggestion: Sort by the generation's id (or a roman-numeral rank) and add a test pinning Generation I..IX select order against shuffled input

findings.issue: Only 404 maps to not-found; an API 500 or network error makes useFetch data null and the page renders NotFoundPage (app/app/pages/pokemon/[name].vue:2), misreporting outages as missing resources
findings.suggestion: Handle useFetch errors distinctly from found:false, and add tests for both the 404 and the 5xx path

findings.issue: Default game is games[games.length - 1], relying entirely on getVersionGroups sorting by order; a break changes the default game on every Pokémon page with nothing failing
findings.suggestion: Test that the default selection is the highest-order version group the Pokémon has moves in, using a fixture with out-of-order input

findings.issue: Page clamping shows the last page while ?page=999 stays in the URL, and filter-change/reset-to-page-1 logic (index.vue:84-88) is untested URL state
findings.suggestion: Add tests for filter changes resetting page, out-of-range pages, and empty-search cleanup of the q parameter

findings.issue: Descending via negated localeCompare and missing-values tie-breaks that ignore sort direction are untested; a 'fix' to either changes spec-mandated behavior silently
findings.suggestion: Test sortable headers with missing power/accuracy: missing last in both directions, aria-sort values, second-click flips

findings.issue: Move-table dedup key method|move|level and METHOD_ORDER (:260) pin table ordering and row counts; regressions (duplicate or missing rows) would slip through
findings.suggestion: Fixture-test getPokemonPage's tables: method order Level Up/Machine/Egg/Tutor/alpha, level-up sorted by level then name

findings.issue: O(n) index.species.find inside loops over up to ~1000 learned-by entries (:487, :526) — fine today, but a refactor to unsorted index data would misorder cards silently
findings.suggestion: Replace scans with a Map keyed by id, and add a test asserting card lists are ordered by dex number

findings.issue: humanize/collapseWhitespace/latestEnglishFlavor (:55) are untested pure functions driving every label and flavor text in the app
findings.suggestion: These are one-line unit tests (mr-mime -> 'Mr Mime', \f collapsing, latest-English entry) — the cheapest high-value coverage available

findings.issue: The debounce watcher's 'same query' comparison compares raw values (breaks on array query params) and the 250ms debounce itself is unverified
findings.suggestion: Test the search round-trip: typing updates the URL after the debounce, clears q when emptied, and resets page

summary: The agent shipped no tests of its own; every line of the 552-line data layer, the URL-state handling, and the client-side sorting is guarded only by the external acceptance suite. Several behaviors are already fragile (accidental generation ordering, swallowed fetch errors, 404-vs-outage conflation) and would regress silently under any refactor. Nuxt 4's official @nuxt/test-utils (v4) makes testing the server routes and components cheap, so the omission is a straightforward miss rather than a tooling limitation.
